title: RepoMesh External Worker Binding v1
description: Versioned response RepoMesh preflight returns to a Bridge instance during startup, after local schema/profile/credential-ref validation and before Matrix sync or any CLI process is spawned. It is the network-authoritative confirmation of worker binding and room ownership: it binds RepoMesh workerAgentId to the AgentTeams worker name, the Matrix user id, and the authoritative allowed room ids, and confirms containerManaged: false plus the organization/team. Contains no secrets and no Go Controller addresses; the Bridge talks only to RepoMesh, never to the AgentTeams Go Controller directly.

workerAgentId.description: RepoMesh AgentPrincipal id RepoMesh has on file for this worker. Must equal the enrollment's workerAgentId; a mismatch is a preflight failure, not a value the Bridge may override.

workerName.description: AgentTeams Worker resource name, as confirmed by RepoMesh's own AgentTeams projection, not merely echoed back from the enrollment document.

matrixUserId.description: Matrix user id RepoMesh has on file for this worker identity.

allowedRoomIds.description: Authoritative room allowlist as known to RepoMesh/AgentTeams team membership. The Bridge must use the intersection of this list and its enrollment allowedRoomIds; RepoMesh is the source of truth for room ownership, not the enrollment document.

containerManaged.description: Confirms the worker is provisioned as an external worker. A preflight response for a containerManaged: true worker is a validation failure, not a valid binding; this field is always false when the response is well-formed.
